title: Cardinal SMP
description: Cardinal SMP is a Friendly, Vanilla+ community focused server that you should join.
body:
![Cardinal SMP Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6754ce2d9d6c45cb6454b910239331102f8c9a0_0.webp)
Cardinal SMP is a Vanilla+ non-pvp based server. We are a community who just wants to have some fun. The server is focused around building, interacting with each other, and doing what you want.

Why should you join? Because you can.. duhh.. But we aim to offer something different. A server that isn't focused around a random plugin. We want to offer an experience.

Links:
- https://map.cardinalsmp.xyz
- https://discord.gg/Nq25nMGzFS

Plugins:
- [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)
- [AuraSkills](https://modrinth.com/plugin/auraskills)
- [AdvancedEnchantments](https://advancedplugins.net/item/AdvancedEnchantments.1)
- [DiscordSRV](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/discordsrv.18494/)
- [Chunky](https://modrinth.com/plugin/chunky)
- [ViaVersion](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/viaversion.19254/)
- [Bluemap](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bluemap)
- Custom Damage Indicator Plugin
